answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and escrows its voyage fingerprint: a copper-stamped route log with an ivory receipt. Auditors compare fingerprints: two sharing one voyage pattern, or one copper seal or ivory receipt reused, burns the bond and flags the rented-fingerprint ring. First costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep the bond.
